help.title: Key bindings
help.body:
Ctrl-A O   port settings
Ctrl-A D   disconnect
Ctrl-A R   reconnect
Ctrl-A E   toggle local echo
Ctrl-A N   toggle timestamps
Ctrl-A L   start/stop log file
Ctrl-A /   find in scrollback (macOS Cmd+F) · Enter/↑ older, Shift+Enter/↓ newer
Ctrl-A C   clear screen
Ctrl-A X   quit
Ctrl-A Z   this help
Ctrl-A Ctrl-A   send Ctrl-A

drag / double-click   select text / word
{copy}   copy · {paste}   paste
Tab   complete command (after running help once)
Tab and control keys   not sent at the prompt (View menu)
Shift+PgUp/PgDn, wheel, scroll bar   scroll
F10   menu
Cmd/Ctrl +/-   font size
